body:
Primary source evidence identifies G6501 as an isomeric hydrate mixture; its record carries the structure of one water-free positional isomer. That chemistry assertion needs correction. Whether two existing source owners denote the same material remains a separate identity decision.

Fresh-main validation and live issue deduplication are complete: Step 7c merge `467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1`; main `467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1`, checked `2026-11-03T00:31:09.269512+00:00`; record/hash and mapping-status comparison `all 67 selected source hashes and the named mapping decisions unchanged`; live deduplication `All-state G6501, exact CAS and owner queries returned zero hits; all six glycerophosphate matches and their full discussions were reviewed, with no dedicated duplicate.`. No record, merge or approval change is included in this finding.

At C5 `9a8414ad88bbbb01c2a43995e3f0decb2e7f2a7e`, `data/ingredients/mapped/Glycerol_Phosphate_Disodium_Salt_Hydrate.yaml` had SHA256 `34a148f0b60690558fc0aa0970a93b619fd340e057a3e07e490000b94d3859bc`, primary `cas:55073-41-1`, type `SINGLE_INGREDIENT`, and formula/InChI/SMILES for one water-free positional isomer. Its original CultureBotHT row specifies Sigma G6501, glycerol phosphate disodium salt hydrate and CAS 55073-41-1. The source's mass 216.04 is the dry-compound basis, not evidence of whole-hydrate stoichiometry.

[GSRS RCS9EQ01V4](https://gsrs.ncats.nih.gov/api/v1/substances/RCS9EQ01V4?view=full) identifies CAS 55073-41-1 as a mixture with required sodium 2-glycerophosphate pentahydrate and sodium 1-glycerophosphate hexahydrate components. It links [NCIT:C120561 Sodium Glycerophosphate](https://api-evsrest.nci.nih.gov/api/v1/concept/ncit/C120561?include=full), whose synonyms include the disodium salt hydrate. The successful [Sigma-Aldrich depositor capture, PubChem SID24895257](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/substance/sid/24895257/JSON), version 6, source `G6501_SIGMA`, explicitly calls the product an isomeric mixture. Response SHA256: `229b66301e98e2ea1a4b8fc032121244c80376c398a9d31e45759c0be917937a`. The direct supplier HTML request timed out; that failure is preserved separately and is not supplier-page verification.

The single water-free positional structure is therefore unsupported as exact chemistry for this source material. This extends #321's missing-hydrate-number concern and #268's enrichment-mechanism concern. It does not establish fixed bulk water content or justify averaging component hydrates into a formula.

At the inspected snapshot, `Sodium_glycerophosphate.yaml` already owned NCIT:C120561 with a SUPPORTED mapping, CultureMech provenance and counts 25/25. G6501 had counts 0/0 and two WITHHOLD mappings. Shared CAS/ontology metadata warrants comparison of the source boundaries; it does not authorize merging, moving occurrences or inheriting support. Recommend a guarded correction that removes the unsupported whole-mixture structural assertion or scopes it accurately, preserving the record and historical chemistry in its audit trail. Resolve shared identity and supplied-form sufficiency separately. Preserve the provisional carbon-source role and native holds; leave #1053's raw pentahydrate objects and #1020's corrected 2-phosphate record unchanged.

Historical deduplication covered #901, #268, #669, #321, #459, #296, #1020, #1053 and #1005, plus structured and semantic holds. All-state searches for the owner name, glycerophosphate, CAS 55073-41-1 and G6501 found no dedicated catalogue-mixture chemistry issue. This was a bounded search; the fresh live result above likewise found no dedicated duplicate. Findings `SEM:d5e18debeee10a3a9cfe` and `SEM:e22f4ed68806ce354630` concerned the older narrative and provisional role and remained OPEN in the preflight.

Evidence SHA256 values: GSRS `930bfa931206f64225a94fa9aaeee12240f217f918b3f59551fb5dc531b2ff33`; NCIt `8f36309df9aae2aa5f10857cffce7184c0fb0632f536761fa8f619b7c44dd5e8`; catalogue CSV `76b70a1836b25de431c4f5cc27c72bb6b06a223ce33911e93b7681d4fcdb28f9`. The CSV was historically captured as an untracked source file from the CultureBotHT checkout at revision `1f27c43b1d5c7d15c08b45fc675d91b6ee938371`; it is not claimed to be a Git blob at that revision.

Completion requires a source-boundary ruling before identity edits, guarded provenance-preserving changes, synchronized source/SSSOM/export and receipt checks, preservation of the supported owner's authority unless explicitly superseded, and independent final-head review. The unified snapshot and its budget remain outside this finding.

Fresh evidence ledger: `output/approved-plan-20261101T031134Z/step7d-postmerge-context/FINAL_HANDOFF.json`, SHA256 `f10813a7c8ed96fa443c71d3e6cdf0369a3ddf9548aaf651b62fd75bd7b9f410`. Current owner and mapping readbacks are retained under `step7d-postmerge-467aa319/`; original primary captures and immutable native preflight remain under `step7d-preflight/scientific-preflight/`. This issue grants no scientific approval and has no supervisor or cycle binding.

comments.body:
The completed source refresh confirms the unsupported whole-material chemistry; the shared-owner identity remains unresolved. The Step 7d assessment has stopped before the required full review because the coordinator verified a separate workflow stop condition. No source or mapping changes have been applied, and this issue remains open.

At main `467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1`, `Glycerol_Phosphate_Disodium_Salt_Hydrate.yaml` still has SHA256 `34a148f0b60690558fc0aa0970a93b619fd340e057a3e07e490000b94d3859bc`. On 2026-11-03 UTC, successful primary GET responses reproduced the previously inspected bytes:

- [Sigma-Aldrich's PubChem SID24895257](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/substance/sid/24895257/JSON), version 6, source `G6501_SIGMA`, names an isomeric mixture; SHA256 `229b66301e98e2ea1a4b8fc032121244c80376c398a9d31e45759c0be917937a`.
- [GSRS RCS9EQ01V4](https://gsrs.ncats.nih.gov/api/v1/substances/RCS9EQ01V4?view=full) classifies CAS 55073-41-1 as a mixture and lists sodium 2-glycerophosphate pentahydrate and sodium 1-glycerophosphate hexahydrate as required components; SHA256 `930bfa931206f64225a94fa9aaeee12240f217f918b3f59551fb5dc531b2ff33`.
- [NCIT:C120561](https://api-evsrest.nci.nih.gov/api/v1/concept/ncit/C120561?include=full) retains the same CAS/UNII and disodium-hydrate synonym; SHA256 `8f36309df9aae2aa5f10857cffce7184c0fb0632f536761fa8f619b7c44dd5e8`.

These sources do not support the record's single water-free positional formula/InChI/SMILES as exact chemistry of the whole supplied material. Removing that unsupported active chemistry can be scoped without merging owners. A future guarded correction should preserve the prior values and history, retain the sourced catalogue context, and avoid replacing them with an averaged formula, guessed water count or inferred component proportions. The supplier-deposited record is distinct from the earlier failed supplier-HTML request; that failure remains failed evidence.

This does not settle assignment to the existing `Sodium_glycerophosphate` owner, whose current identifier is NCIT:C120561 and whose source context is CultureMech. Shared registry/ontology metadata does not determine whether those source occurrences and the G6501 catalogue material should share one record. No identity reassignment, occurrence transfer, inherited support or merge is justified by this partial assessment.

Recommendation: drop G6501 from the proposed #901 identity/predicate migration until its source boundary is resolved, keeping its existing holds and provisional role. The narrower chemistry cleanup may be considered separately when authorized execution resumes; it would not by itself close this issue's ownership question. This interrupted assessment is not a completed native per-owner review, a new mapping approval or a resolution of #1118. Evidence and GET receipts are retained under `output/approved-plan-20261101T031134Z/step7d-execution-20261103/priority-science/`.

title: G6501 glycerophosphate hydrate mixture carries unsupported single-isomer chemistry
